sources.title: 法国国图敦煌写卷 Pelliot chinois 4071 馆目与题记
sources.quality_notes: 14 folios. Astrology part f.1r–8r. The catalog converts the dated Kang Zun and Lingzhou colophon to 975-01-25; this is the date of the inscription as cataloged, not a blanket date for all parts of the object.

sources.title: P.4071 的 R 26112 替代件数字影像说明
sources.provider: Gallica metadata mirrored on Wikimedia Commons
sources.quality_notes: The object description explicitly reports a digitization from substitute R 26112. Both Gallica object IDs map to the same P.4071 shelfmark; exclude independent historical witness counting. Original folio mapping and glyphs were not inspected.

sources.title: Isahaya 与 Lin 2017 年 P.4071 前37栏转录与研究
sources.quality_notes: DOI 10.34336/historiascientiarum.26.3_153. Printed pp.157–160. Col.1 records three stem-branch pairs and shen-hour without a recorded hour stem; cols.7–17 locate luminaries by lodge and zodiacal sign. Punctuation and selected character normalizations are editorial.

sources.title: Mak 2014 年《聿斯经》研究及敦煌写卷影印入口
sources.quality_notes: Printed pp.156–163 identified by Isahaya and Lin as the reproduction route for the astrology text. The image captions identify P.4071. No original glyph collated through this route.

sources.title: 《敦煌研究》2025年第5期 P.4071 新探公开摘要
sources.quality_notes: Public abstract advances Cao Yangong as an inferred client. Its hypothesis is recorded without determining identity or adopting any unexamined argument from the full article.

sources.title: 杜牧《自撰墓铭》晚唐星宿与宫位叙述
sources.provider: Wikisource transcription of Fanchuan Wenji, Siku recension
sources.quality_notes: Fanchuan Wenji vol.6 locates the illness/eighth palace and the good fortune/eleventh palace with celestial bodies and lodges. Original stone and exact composition date unbound.

sources.title: 《四库全书总目·星命溯源》引杜牧墓铭
sources.provider: Shidian Guji transmission of the Siku catalog
sources.quality_notes: The catalog entry explicitly excerpts Du Mu about lunar lodges, palaces and planets. The citation establishes Qing reception; exact source exemplar and later rule genealogy are unbound.

sources.title: 吴融《送策上人》「八字如相許」
sources.quality_notes: The poem addresses a monk, and the line invokes a decision to leave office. The phrase occurs, while its interpretation and any mechanics remain unresolved.

sources.title: 吴融《寄貫休上人》「八字微言不復聞」
sources.quality_notes: A second poem by Wu Rong addressed to a monk. The passage provides context for considering a Buddhist interpretation of the other poem.

sources.title: 清翟灏《通俗编》卷二十一〈八字〉
sources.quality_notes: The Eight Characters entry cites Song Ce Shangren and allows a fate-calculation reading in a question about Tang practice. The following Twelve Palaces entry also relays Du Mu through a prior work.

sources.title: 赵卫邦1946年四柱史研究与吴融两诗的佛教释义
sources.quality_notes: Printed p.295 reads the two monk-addressed poems together, with a Buddhist alternative for Song Ce Shangren. Article reception and stated argument verified; historic authorial intention remains open.

sources.title: 程群2020年浙江民俗研究所引吴融《送策上人》
sources.provider: Journal of Xihua University (Philosophy and Social Sciences)
sources.quality_notes: Printed p.34 reads the verse as evidence of Tang marriage matching. This records one modern reading, not an independent Tang procedural witness.

unresolved_lineage_questions: Can f.1r, f.2v and f.8r be compared through the original-image and substitute-image routes against diplomatic transcriptions?
What independently dated Song–Yuan texts provide named and operational continuity toward the Ming Ziwei print families?
Which dated natal calculation records explicitly attest the four stem-branch pairs, the hour-stem rule, and day-master mechanics?
Does a contemporary gloss or parallel use adjudicate the semantics of Wu Rong’s Song Ce Shangren?
